title: Short burn time, poor packaging
text: Short burn time, poor packaging. Wish they lasted longer. Also, this product was not packaged with any thought given to protection of the product at all--just shrink-wrapped. The tealights all around the outside of the package were dented on the edges, especially on the top layer. It appears package of tealights was not handled with care prior to shipping. They would fare better if they were boxed (as some competitors are). Decent tealights with a short life. Completely odorless, burn for 3-3.5 hours. One star added for the high-quality wicks of consistent length (about 1 cm). One star added for the clean burn they provide and the molding process they use which adds a small dimple in the center of the tealight to keep the initial pooling of wax around the wick. Sadly, the poor packaging and short burn time kill them for me. Will try another brand next time.
